CustomField.label: Order
CustomField.description: Scenario 1 (Order model, requirements v3 of 1 Oct 2026; Swati 5 Oct 2026): the activated Order this setup request is for. Set by the publishing Flow on PROVISIONING rows (one row per Order and product line, Group_Key__c = <OrderId>:PROVISIONING:<LINE_CODE>). MuleSoft reads it to list the Order Products of the row's product line (modules on the ticket, duplicate label) and never writes it. Blank on Opportunity-model rows and on DEACTIVATION rows.
